$comment: PLAN-D (feedback wave 2026-09-17, Derek's decision 2) — hands-free pause and resume by voice. The ONE shared contract for both clients: the command grammar (plain "pause" / "resume" since Decision 36), the acceptance and near-miss vectors, the five spoken strings and the resume tone's parameters. Canonical copy lives here; iOS carries byte-identical copies (app bundle + test fixtures), pinned by scripts/check-voice-pause-fixture-sync.sh as a CertMateUnified/deploy-testflight.sh preflight. Tests assert against the keys in this file, never against literals.

grammar.$comment: Decision 36 (TAKEN 2026-09-24): the command is exactly one word said on its own — "pause" or "resume". Whole-utterance match, case-insensitive, punctuation-stripped, no prefix, no brand word, no aliases, no fuzzy matching (the 2026-06-24 hard rule). Normalisation runs in the order listed; the pattern is then matched against the normalised text. (Before Decision 36 the grammar required the brand word "CertMate"; Flux transcribed it as "So it may", "Search made to" and "Certainly made" in the device smoke.)
normalisation: replace every character outside [a-z0-9] with a space
collapse runs of whitespace to one space and trim

keyterm_brand_forms.$comment: Recognition aid only, no longer part of the command grammar (Decision 36). The brand forms stay on both web keyterm lists and the iOS keyword boosts so the product name is transcribed well in ordinary speech.

strings.$comment: Decision 10 (TAKEN 2026-09-20) pins the first four; Decision 24(c) (TAKEN 2026-09-21) approves resume_line and retires resume_ack FOR THE VOICE-PAUSE ROUTE ONLY (a per-entry flag, not a deletion, so its bytes stay pinned). A test that enumerates what the voice-pause route PRODUCES reads each entry's status and finds four. Every string is also a must-not-command vector. Decision 36 (TAKEN 2026-09-24) rewords pause_ack, reminder and still_paused_cue to name the new command 'resume'.

reminder.text: Still paused. Say 'resume' to carry on.
reminder.decision: WAVE-CONTEXT.md Decision 10 (TAKEN 2026-09-20), string 3; reworded by Decision 36 (TAKEN 2026-09-24)

still_paused_cue.text: Still paused — say 'resume' on its own to carry on.
still_paused_cue.decision: WAVE-CONTEXT.md Decision 10 (TAKEN 2026-09-20), string 4; reworded by Decision 36 (TAKEN 2026-09-24)

resume_line.text: Carrying on — anything said while paused wasn't recorded.

resume_tone.$comment: Pinned by PARAMETERS, not bytes: web synthesises from oscillators at the AudioContext rate and iOS renders 22.05 kHz PCM into a WAV, so the two cannot be byte-identical and no test may claim they are. Each client asserts its own constants against this object. Envelope per note: linear attack from 0 to peak_amplitude over attack_ms, then exponential decay from peak_amplitude to decay_floor_gain at the note's end.
